Formulas and interpretation

Let A be the filtered changed-area fraction and s = clip((A − 0.01) / 0.99, 0, 1). Hard ceiling C: clip((A − 0.01) / (C − 0.01), 0, 1). Smooth curve: 1.15 × s / (s + 0.15). The smooth curve reaches 1 only when s=1; it avoids a hard plateau on this footage.

The standing baselines remain zero under every candidate. Detection thresholds, 1% noise allowance, frame sampling, and preprocessing are unchanged. These recordings are the calibration baseline; transfer to new equipment remains to be checked. The first 0.6 seconds is unscored. Full-second saturation means every available comparison in that second is at 1.
